pages.title: Hatchet
pages.text: A Pressurised Hatchet is required for certain items to drop from certain mobs, or it will allow extra items to drop from certain mobs.$(br)Similar to a Potato Cannon or Extendo Grip, durability will be consumed when being used but can also utilise backtank pressure.

pages.title: Elastic Strands
pages.text: Regular Elastic Strands come from regular Slimes upon death.$(br)Elastic Strands can either be cut into Slime Balls or be used in a sequenced assembly to make Sllimy.

pages.title: Fiery Elastic Strands
pages.text: Fiery Elastic Strands come from Magma Cubes upon death.$(br)Fiery Elastic Strands can either be cut into Magma Cream or be used in a sequenced assembly to make Fiery Sllimy.

pages.title: Guardian Spikes
pages.text: Guardian Spikes come from Guardians (shocker) upon death.$(br)They can be cut into Prismarine Shards or Crystals, but can also be used in a sequenced assembly to make Glazed Monument Medley.

pages.title: Elder Guardian Spikes
pages.text: Elder Guardian Spikes come from Elder Guardians upon death.$(br)They can be cut into Prismarine Shards or Crystals, but can also be used in a sequenced assembly to make Glazed Monument Medley.

pages.title: Guardian Spike Weapons
pages.text: Both variants of guardian spikes will act like a sword, but cannot be enchanted.

pages.title: Sniffer Fluff
pages.text: Sniffer Fluff, while cannot be made into food, can be used to make decorative building blocks that are akin to a Sniffer's green, moss-like coat.

pages.title: Volatile Organ
pages.text: Volatile Organs are extracted from the guts of a Voltfish.$(br)These organs can be cut into a Bone and some pieces of Voltfish Meat.
